# The Standard

> > London's leading voice for news, sport, culture, and lifestyle—from Arsenal FC and Champions League coverage to West End arts, celebrity culture, and business insights.

The Standard (formerly Evening Standard) delivers comprehensive coverage of London and UK affairs, including breaking news, football analysis, restaurant reviews, shopping guides, and cultural commentary. Key contributors include Melanie McDonagh, Matt Verri, and David Ellis.

## Key Topics

- London news and culture
- Arsenal FC and Champions League
- UK business and economics
- Celebrity culture and mental health
- Restaurant reviews and omakase dining
- West End arts and exhibitions
- Shopping and lifestyle guides
- Six Nations rugby
- Mortgage rates and property
- Peaky Blinders and UK film
- Bipolar disorder awareness
- Black Friday deals
- Gift guides and recommendations
- Social media regulation
- NHS and national insurance policy
